note_en: 即使……也…… means "even if... still...": 即使不能每天陪伴在身边，也希望用这些方式弥补距离带来的遗憾 "even if they can't be by their parents' side every day, they still hope to make up for the distance this way." English puts "even if" in one clause and needs nothing in the other, but Chinese normally pairs 即使 with 也 before the verb of the main clause, as again in 即使不住进养老院，也能在家中获得专业照顾.
